Doesn't matter how serious or realistic you believe it is. The fact is that he is making an attempt to usurp both free and fair elections and, therefore, democracy itself.

There it is. We are finally here. Trump has formally announced his desire to cancel a U.S. election.

We said he would do this, and now he has. It doesn't matter that he probably can't. Or that he'll lose in court. The point is that we've crossed a line with respect to American democracy.
